rationale: FX01 flagged missing principal_amount_usd for rows treated as non-USD debt principal. The raw schedule of investments presents the Principal, Amortized Cost, and Fair Value columns in dollars; rows with explicit dollar markers and continuation rows share the same USD-denominated column structure. No raw-source evidence found a EUR/GBP/CAD or other non-USD principal basis, so the flag appears to arise from interpreting blank repeated currency symbols as non-USD rather than as table formatting.
